note: v435: The loan Schedule now opens on where you actually are in your payments instead of a static list you scroll forever. Below the yearly summary it shows a focused window — a few paid rows for context, then your upcoming payments, with the next one due highlighted (◀ NEXT) and a 'Payment X of N coming up' header. 'Show all N payments' still reveals the complete schedule. The window is balance-derived, so skipped, extra, and lump-sum payments move it honestly.
